text: On the glass case. <break time="0.8s" /> Stood a tiger made of papier mâché. <break time="0.8s" /> Which kept nodding its head. <break time="0.8s" /> In a slow and regular way. <break time="0.8s" /> There were also magic mirrors. <break time="0.8s" /> One of which stretched us long and thin. <break time="0.8s" /> While another swelled our heads. <break time="0.8s" /> And made our legs vanish. <break time="0.8s" /> While we were laughing at the mirrors. <break time="0.8s" /> The shopman appeared. <break time="0.8s" /> A pale man. <break time="0.8s" /> With one ear larger than the other. <break time="0.8s" /> When I asked for a few simple tricks. <break time="0.8s" /> For my boy. <break time="0.8s" /> He took a glass ball. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of his own head. <break time="0.8s" /> And held it out to Gip. <break time="0.8s" /> Gip reached for it. <break time="0.8s" /> But his hand closed on nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And the shopman said calmly. <break time="0.8s" /> It is in your pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> And there it was. <break time="0.8s" /> He then took more balls. <break time="0.8s" /> From his elbow and the back of his neck. <break time="0.8s" /> And he would take no money. <break time="0.8s" /> For them at all. <break time="0.8s" /> He gave me a card. <break time="0.8s" /> That said Genuine Magic Shop. <break time="0.8s" /> And he said firmly. <break time="0.8s" /> That there was absolutely no deception. <break time="0.8s" /> In his shop. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he smiled at Gip and said. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was the Right Sort of Boy. <break time="0.8s" /> The only sort. <break time="0.8s" /> That could get through the doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> A little boy outside rattled the door. <break time="0.8s" /> And howled. <break time="0.8s" /> But it stayed firmly shut. <break time="0.8s" /> And someone carried him away. <break time="0.8s" /> The door is locked. <break time="0.8s" /> For that sort of child. <break time="0.8s" /> The shopman explained. <break time="0.8s" /> And he flicked a few colored sparks. <break time="0.8s" /> From his fingers.
